method: Government aid to Ukraine (military, financial, humanitarian; allocations/disbursements, not loan guarantees) for the 190 countries outside the Kiel Ukraine Support Tracker, EUR bn per calendar year (2026 = Jan-Aug). (1) UN OCHA FTS incoming flows to Ukraine by usage year, government donors only, status paid (low) or paid+commitment (central/high), deduplicated by flow id. (2) Documented government donations outside FTS (official statements, news), with ranges where values are partial; unvalued in-kind cargo valued at EUR/USD 2-10k per tonne. (3) Announced pledges whose delivery is only partly visible in FTS: central adds 50% of the unrecorded remainder, high adds 100%. (4) Every country's high bound adds an unrecorded-donation band for small donations missing from FTS: 0.002% of GDP (2022), 0.0005% (2023-2025), 0.00033% (Jan-Aug 2026); the 2022 rate is above every documented non-Western small donor except Serbia and Timor-Leste. Countries with no record anywhere: low 0, central 0, high = band. Belarus, North Korea, Iran, Syria: 0/0/0. USD converted at ECB yearly averages.

fx.basis: USD per EUR, ECB yearly averages
